Game Overview

Flying Princess Runner puts players into a casual experience centered on embark on a magical adventure as the Flying Princess. Glide through enchanting landscapes, collect hidden treasures, and unlock powerful upgrades. With intuitive controls and thrilling challenges, hone your skills to dodge obstacles and explore this endless fairy tale realm filled with wonder and excitement for all ages.
